global.Title: Environmental Hazard Index for Alaska, 1 km (TEST: team decisions are not final)
global.Abstract: Low / Medium / High classes for three hazard indices (wildfire, erosion, permafrost) and the combined Environmental Hazard, on a 1 km grid over Alaska (EPSG:3338). Each index puts every cell in a class using a variant and boundaries chosen by the team in the Environmental Hazard Index workbench; the combining rule then gives the hazard class. TEST coverage for front-end development: the decisions, and so the classes, will change.
global.Institution: Scenarios Network for Alaska and Arctic Planning (SNAP), University of Alaska Fairbanks
